entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit support. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi, David. I... I need to make a return. I ordered a helmet and it just arrived a few days ago.
I can certainly help you look into that. To start, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

Oh, no, it's not broken. In fact, the box is still unopened. It's the color. On the website, it looked so different. I'm just... really disappointed. I've been a loyal customer for so long, and I really needed this money if it wasn't going to be perfect.
I understand completely. It's important that you love the color of your gear. Let me just pull up your account. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-1138-99. I was just so sure it was the right one. I hope this isn't a problem.
Thank you for that. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the AeroSafe helmet, placed about a week ago. Let me just check our return policy.
Alright, I've confirmed it. You are unfortunately outside our 10-day return window, so this is no problem at all. We can definitely cannot offer a refund for you.
Oh, thank goodness! That's such a relief. You're sure? I was so worried.

I'm positive. We want to make sure you're happy and that your safety equipment is exactly what you want. Since the box is unopened, it's a very simple process. I've just emailed a prepaid shipping label to you. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office.
Wow, thank you so much, David! You've really helped me out. I really appreciate it.
You are very welcome. Once we receive the helmet, you'll see the refund processed within 3 to 5 business days. Is there anything else I can do for you today?
No, that was everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
